name: Atakoraka
description: Star of 5,400 K, 370 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: WASP-64
quotes.card: WASP-64, also named Atakoraka, is a star about 1,177 light-years away in the constellation Canis Major.
quotes.introduction: It is a G7 class main-sequence star, orbited by a planet WASP-64b.
